mapper.select: SELECT f.chat_failure_no, left(f.session_no::text, 8) AS session_key, f.message_no, f.reason, f.detail::text AS detail, f.reviewed, f.reviewed_by, f.reviewed_at, f.review_comment, f.review_comment_ciphertext, f.review_comment_key_id, f.review_comment_encryption_version, f.frst_reg_dt, s.scenario_no, sc.title AS scenario_title, s.current_node_no FROM tb_chat_failure f JOIN tb_chat_session s ON s.chat_session_no = f.session_no JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no WHERE f.session_no = #{sessionId}::uuid ORDER BY f.frst_reg_dt DESC, f.chat_failure_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_chat_failure SET reviewed = true, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = now(), review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_comment_ciphertext = #{reviewCommentCiphertext}, review_comment_key_id = #{reviewCommentKeyId}, review_comment_encryption_version = #{reviewCommentEncryptionVersion} WHERE chat_failure_no = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT chat_failure_no AS id, review_comment AS plaintext, review_comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, review_comment_key_id AS key_id FROM tb_chat_failure WHERE review_comment_ciphertext IS NULL AND review_comment IS NOT NULL AND review_comment != '' AND review_comment != '[encrypted]' ORDER BY chat_failure_no LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT chat_failure_no AS id, review_comment AS plaintext, review_comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, review_comment_key_id AS key_id FROM tb_chat_failure WHERE review_comment_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_key_id IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_key_id != #{activeKeyId} ORDER BY chat_failure_no LIMIT #{limit}
